event.text: Thanks for coming in. So tell me, what are you working on right now?

event.text: Um, so right now I'm building a speech coach that you wear on your wrist.

event.speaker: other
event.text: Oh interesting, how does it actually decide when to buzz you, is it

event.speaker: me
event.text: So basically it listens to the conversation, um, and it uses Deepgram for the words and who is talking, and then a judge model looks at every turn I take, and, um, if I interrupt or I ramble or I say um a lot it sends a haptic to my phone, and basically the phone buzzes with a pattern, like two sharp taps for an interrupt and three rising taps when I have talked too long, and um the whole point is you learn in the moment instead of watching a recording later, and we also track your hands with the band's motion sensor, so if you fidget while someone else is talking it nudges you to keep your hands calm, and at the end you get a spoken debrief with one thing you did well and one thing to fix, written as a plan for next time, and um basically that is it.

event.speaker: me
event.text: What would make it useful for your team?
